title: PR8053 Production full-role proof consumer environment impact closure

phases.objective: Bind the durable Production full-role inspection producer to the canonical role-selection proof consumer while preserving fail-closed cross-environment review and all existing mutation boundaries.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed repository automation and recovery proof resolver
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Evaluate the exact PR head and resolve a canonical read-only full-role inspection artifact into mutation-grade role-selection proof without executing any mutation.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The consumer accepts only the canonical full_role_inspection artifact and exact source/target bindings, derives selected roles exactly from proven zero-object roles, and the shared-runtime change remains explicitly governed for staging and production with live staging certification required.
steps: Classify the exact base-to-head change set against the canonical environment-impact policy.
Require the canonical full_role_inspection artifact name and full-role-inspection.json entry instead of the legacy dry_run artifact contract.
Require full_inspection=true, exact Production SHA binding, a canonical target fingerprint, and selected rebuild roles equal to the proven zero-object role set.
Reject ambiguous, stale, legacy, mismatched, or mutation-bearing evidence fail closed.
Require live Staging certification for the shared-runtime consumer change before any governed promotion decision.
Keep Production mutation, database mutation, migration apply, grant mutation, provider mutation, and Breakglass execution outside this PR.
assertions: The environment impact declaration is bound to the canonical deployment branch policy.
Shared-runtime impact is explicitly declared for both staging and production and cross-environment review is true.
The durable proof resolver accepts only canonical read-only full-role evidence bound to the expected Production SHA and target fingerprint.
Selected rebuild roles must exactly equal the zero-object roles proven by the durable inspection artifact.
No Production deploy, database/schema/grant mutation, provider mutation, Breakglass execution, raw SQL, or shell authority is introduced or authorized by this declaration.
